prompt: A lexer turns text into tokens and remembers each token's starting byte offset. Predict what `lex` returns for each input.
explain: Longer operators are tried first, so `<=` is one token. The error reports the byte offset of the unsupported character. A `#` comment runs to the newline, so the `7` after it starts at byte 7. A number that does not fit in `i64` is `NumberTooBig` at its start.
